# Vendored third-party files

## CSInterface.js

Adobe's CEP bridge — the panel cannot call ExtendScript without it.

- Version: 11.0.0
- Source: <https://github.com/Adobe-CEP/CEP-Resources> (`CEP_11.x/CSInterface.js`)
- Retrieved: 2026-08-31

Adobe's header permits use, modification, and distribution of this file when
obtained from Adobe. It was taken from Adobe's own repository, so vendoring it
here is within those terms. Do not edit it — replace it wholesale from
upstream when moving CEP versions.
